title: Explain, later, to lock
summary: Words are built from parts: com-pliquer (to complicate) and ex-pliquer (to explain) share pliquer, 'to fold'. You also learn tard (late), plus tard (later), un peu de (a bit of) and fermer à clé (to lock).
points: de = of: un peu de gâteau = a bit of cake.
explication → expliquer (to explain), complication → compliquer. The m of com- is barely pronounced.
Taking words apart helps you remember them better than memorising them.
tard = late (the d is silent, like 'tardy'). plus tard = later (literally 'more late'). The s of plus is silent here.
fermer à clé = to lock (literally 'close with key'). clé = key.
À plus tard ! = See you later!
drills: Do you want a bit of cake?
Tu veux un peu de gâteau ?
I want to order the cake.
Je peux réserver quelque chose plus tard.
Peux-tu organiser quelque chose plus tard ?
Peux-tu commander quelque chose plus tard ?
I want to reserve something a little later.
Je veux réserver quelque chose un peu plus tard.
Tu peux fermer la porte à clé.
You can lock the door later.
Tu peux fermer la porte à clé plus tard.
